questions.question: In God's message about the two sisters Oholah and Oholibah, which people did Oholah lust after, the warriors clothed in blue?
God handed the sister Oholah over to the very lovers she had lusted after. True or false?
In the story of the two sisters, what did Oholibah do after she saw what happened to her sister Oholah?

answers.text: She became even worse than her sister
She turned back to God for good
She grieved and stayed away from lovers

questions.question: God told Oholibah she would drink the cup of her sister Samaria. Why did He give her that cup?

answers.text: She took over her sister's land
